name: Heal Pulse
description: The target restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half up. If the user has the Mega Launcher Ability, the target instead restores 3/4 of its maximum HP, rounded half down.
flags: Blocked by Detect, Protect, Spiky Shield, and if not a Status move, King's Shield.
Bounced back to the original user by Magic Coat or the Ability Magic Bounce.
Can target a Pokemon positioned anywhere in a Triple Battle.
Prevented from being executed or selected during Heal Block's effect.
The move plays its animation when used on an ally.
Power is multiplied by 1.5 when used by a Pokemon with the Ability Mega Launcher.
